author.bio: Aquinas was a thirteenth-century theologian and philosopher. His Summa Theologiae became a major work of Christian intellectual history, although he did not complete it.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The reported declaration explains why Aquinas stopped writing near the end of his life, leaving his theological project unfinished. The English words used here come through a modern translation of biographical testimony, not an English sentence written by Aquinas.
